name: Sourdough
description: Bread risen slowly on a wild starter instead of packet yeast.

tcm.note: Fermentation is read as warming; the base grain is wheat.

ayurveda.note: A long sour ferment is firmly ushna — sourness is the marker.

unani.note: Garam-khushk, more so than a quickly risen loaf.

histamine.note: A long wild ferment builds histamine, though SIGHI itself hedges on very long-proved sourdough rather than ruling it out — treat as uncertain, not settled.
